summary: Parameterless thunk that passes the address of the subroutine sub_4F23C0 (cast to int) to BooleanToIntConversion at 0x00587B3E and returns its result. Structural twin of the other short-computation thunk; the legacy ABI tag labels this a short-computation callback registration, whose exact semantics are not resolved from the raw body.

local_names.sub_4F23C0: function whose address is handed to BooleanToIntConversion

operations.description: Invokes BooleanToIntConversion with the function pointer sub_4F23C0 (its address cast to int) as the sole argument; this is the only side effect of the thunk.
Returns the int result produced by BooleanToIntConversion from the wrapped short computation.

unresolved: Whether BooleanToIntConversion registers sub_4F23C0 as a callback or invokes it and converts a boolean result is not visible in this thunk.
The identity of the object that owns the short computation remains unknown; the abi tag is LEGACY and names no class.
sub_4F23C0 is only referenced as a value here; its own body is out of scope.
